answer.headline: Data scientist with six years of experience in retail and logistics analytics, focused on forecasting, pricing models and A/B testing

experiences.title: Senior Data Scientist
experiences.summary: Built a LightGBM demand forecasting model for 4,000 products across 120 stores, cutting forecast error by 18% against a moving-average baseline. Designed and analysed A/B tests of pricing and promotion changes, maintains 60 dbt models in Snowflake feeding commercial dashboards, and mentors two junior data scientists.
